title: Forms of Energy and Energy Transformations
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Energy transformation model analysis using energy flow diagrams and energy type charts. No heating or flame activity is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for thermochemistry, gas behavior, phase changes, and solutions
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the energy model screen. Use the system or intro screen and identify the energy source, transfer path, and receiver. Change one control at a time, such as heating, cooling, friction, or motion, depending on the screen available. Record the starting energy form, ending energy form, transfer direction, and the evidence that supports the lesson's energy claim.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
